scientific_question: Do completed Deribit BTC/ETH option aggressor transactions contain delta-hedging or gamma-rebalancing information that predicts which frozen Bybit external-liquidity pool is reached first strongly enough to create positive after-cost account growth?
trader_explanation: Confirmed prior 30-minute Bybit BBO extremes are the frozen external buy-side and sell-side liquidity pools.
Completed Deribit option transactions are converted into signed delta demand and dealer gamma inventory pressure using analytically reconstructed point-in-time Greeks.
The model predicts which frozen pool will be drawn first; it does not label FVG, order block, breaker, session or candle pattern entries.
Calibrated probability and the two structural distances define one exact cost-adjusted long, short or flat decision.
The selected pool is the target and the opposite pool is the stop; no elapsed-time exit is permitted.

data_contract.deribit_clock: exchange timestamp and local row order within the Deribit capture
data_contract.bybit_entry: first Bybit BBO at or after completed-window end plus two seconds, no more than one second late
data_contract.source_integrity: full GZIP CRC, byte count, SHA-256, row count and local_timestamp monotonicity

greek_contract.instrument_scope: BTC and ETH European options with 1 hour to 14 days remaining
greek_contract.spot: last valid same-underlier Bybit BBO midpoint at or before the option trade, maximum age two seconds
greek_contract.premium: Deribit base-asset premium multiplied by point-in-time spot
greek_contract.solver: Black-Scholes zero-rate implied-volatility bisection from 1% to 500%

chronology.development_access: only after every confirmation gate passes

label_and_execution.liquidity_pools: maximum completed Bybit bid and minimum completed Bybit ask over the prior 30 minutes
label_and_execution.label: which frozen pool is first touched after the actual entry boundary
label_and_execution.same_100ms_bucket_both_touch: AMBIGUOUS and stop-first in account replay
label_and_execution.source_gap: label unresolved; any authorized position pays the full structural stop
label_and_execution.sample_boundary: any authorized unresolved position pays the full structural stop

account.funding: adverse two-bp reserve for each crossed UTC 00:00/08:00/16:00 boundary
account.counterfactual_winner_removal: remove the largest positive 10% event keys before global-slot routing and replay from initial NAV

conditional_decision.zero_confirmation_survivors: retire the exact option-flow information unit without model, feature, probability, range, risk or leverage tuning
conditional_decision.development_survivor: freeze the exact rule for broader continuous pre-2024 reconstruction and exact Bybit depth/funding validation before official 2024
